name: District of Columbia
agency: DC Department of Human Services, Economic Security Administration (for DHCF)

period.description: For people living at home, spend down uses a one-month budget period; for long-term care it is six months.

submission.description: Give your paid and unpaid medical bills to your caseworker. Send extra bills within the budget period; each should show the care, provider, patient, service date and amount you owe.

notes: Medicare and other health insurance premiums, deductibles and co-insurance count.
Bills paid by Medicare, other insurance or Medicaid cannot be used. Each bill can be used only once.
If insurance pays part of a bill, only the part you must pay counts.
Bills for your spouse, or for a child you are responsible for, can count too.
